title: Residual task leak: rx.recv blocks forever with narrow type filter and no broadcasts
description: When a client connects with a narrow type filter (e.g. types=Message) and no broadcast of ANY type is ever sent on the channel, the coalescing task blocks indefinitely at rx.recv().await (events.rs line 321). The is_closed() fix (line 375) only runs after a broadcast arrives and the batch is empty — it is never reached in the zero-broadcast scenario. The task lives as long as the broadcast channel is alive (i.e., as long as the daemon runs), which is a task leak for every such connection. This is a distinct scenario from the one fixed in this commit (which covered the case where broadcasts arrive but all are filtered out).
